verdict.rationale: Some of what a user leaves behind is already portable. Configuration lives as a `.coderabbit.yaml` file in your own repository, and `@coderabbitai configuration` returns the resolved config as YAML. Review output such as summaries and walkthrough comments is posted directly into PRs on your Git host, so it stays there if you leave. However, nothing in the evidence documents an export feature for CodeRabbit-held data such as learnings, review context, dashboard metrics or Triage state, and the data-retention docs only cover storage and opt-out, not export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, export of learnings and review history in open formats, export of dashboard and Triage data, documented API endpoints for bulk export, and any independent confirmation that users can cleanly leave with their data.
